rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for one side facing or opposing another, including a sports matchup.

example.english: Tonight's match is Hong Kong versus Japan.
example.traditional: 今晚場波係香港隊對日本隊。
example.jyutping: gam1 maan5 coeng4 bo1 hai6 hoeng1 gong2 deoi6 deoi3 jat6 bun2 deoi6

rows.note: Use this for an ordinary comparison rather than an adversarial matchup.

example.english: This new phone has much better battery life versus the old one.
example.traditional: 呢部新手機同舊嗰部比，電量耐好多。
example.jyutping: ne1 bou6 san1 sau2 gei1 tung4 gau6 go2 bou6 bei2 din6 loeng6 noi6 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this formal construction in the title of a legal case, with the claimant first and the defendant second.

example.english: The case is titled Chan Tai-man versus Lee Siu-ming.
example.traditional: 份判詞嘅案件標題寫住「陳大文訴李小明」。
example.jyutping: fan6 pun3 ci4 ge3 on3 gin2 biu1 tai4 se2 zyu6 can4 daai6 man4 sou3 lei5 siu2 ming4
